lines.zh: 我穿过林子，树在我前面先弯了。
lines.en: I cross the woods, and the trees bend before I reach them.

lines.zh: 我的步子不快，但每一步都更近。
lines.en: My stride is not fast, but every step is nearer.

lines.zh: 我走在田埂上，庄稼朝两边倒。
lines.en: I walk the field ridge and the crops fall to either side.

lines.zh: 地面被我的重量压出浅坑，形状不对。
lines.en: My weight presses shallow pits that are the wrong shape.

lines.zh: 我沿着你走过的路走，一个弯都没错。
lines.en: I follow your trail and miss no turn.

lines.zh: 我走路时不出声，衣服却在响。
lines.en: My steps are silent, but my clothes make noise.

lines.zh: 我从水里走过，水面没有裂开。
lines.en: I walk through water and the surface does not part.

lines.zh: 我经过窗户，玻璃上映不出我。
lines.en: I pass a window, and no reflection appears.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂得太低，几乎碰到地。
lines.en: My arms hang too low, almost brushing the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，像在给你时间跑。
lines.en: I move slowly, as if giving you time to run.

lines.zh: 我踩过你的火把，光暗了一截。
lines.en: I step over your torch and the light dims.

lines.zh: 我转身时，身后的方向已经换了。
lines.en: When I turn, the way behind me has changed.

lines.zh: 我站在树后，只露出半个肩。
lines.en: I stand behind a tree with one shoulder showing.

lines.zh: 我不动，你却能听见我在呼吸。
lines.en: I do not move, yet you can hear me breathing.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，像在听你心跳。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if listening to your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我停在那里很久，久到你以为我看错了。
lines.en: I stay so long you decide you mis-saw.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的身体宽一倍。
lines.en: My shadow is twice as wide as my body.

lines.zh: 我站在门后，等你把灯点起来。
lines.en: I stand behind the door, waiting for you to light the lamp.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙站，墙纸鼓出一块。
lines.en: I stand against the wall and the paper bulges.

lines.zh: 我垂下头，脖子折成一个坏角度。
lines.en: I drop my head, my neck folded at a bad angle.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，眼眶里是干的。
lines.en: I do not blink, and my eyes are dry.

lines.zh: 我静止时，周围的声音被抽走了。
lines.en: When I am still, the sounds around us are drawn away.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬起手，又慢慢放下。
lines.en: I raise a hand slowly, then lower it slowly.

lines.zh: 我把脸转向别处，耳朵仍冲着你。
lines.en: I turn my face away, my ear still aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我站在那里，门缝里的光被我挡住。
lines.en: I stand there and block the light in the doorway.

lines.zh: 我的体重让地板响了一声，就一声。
lines.en: My weight makes the floor creak once, only once.

lines.zh: 我抬起脸，那张脸没有表情。
lines.en: I lift my face, and the face has no expression.

lines.zh: 我隔着窗户看你，看得很仔细。
lines.en: I watch you through the window, very carefully.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛对着你，瞳孔大得过头。
lines.en: My eyes are on you, pupils far too wide.

lines.zh: 你举火把照我，我没有退。
lines.en: You raise a torch at me and I do not retreat.

lines.zh: 我把头往前伸，伸到不合常理。
lines.en: I push my head forward, further than is reasonable.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，等你放下武器。
lines.en: I watch your hands, waiting for you to lower the weapon.

lines.zh: 我的嘴慢慢张开，里面没有牙。
lines.en: My mouth opens slowly, and there are no teeth.

lines.zh: 你移开视线，我才跟着动。
lines.en: Only when you look away do I move.

lines.zh: 我低下头，好让你看清我的脸。
lines.en: I lower my head so you can see my face clearly.

lines.zh: 我的脸绷着，像一块压平的布。
lines.en: My face is taut, like flattened cloth.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我一点一点地靠近。
lines.en: While you look at me, I close the distance bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我贴到玻璃上，玻璃起了雾。
lines.en: I press to the glass, and it fogs.

lines.zh: 我把脸贴在窗上，呼出一层雾。
lines.en: I press my face to the window until the glass fogs.

lines.zh: 我对着你笑了一下，笑得很慢。
lines.en: I smile at you, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我看你时，火把的火苗朝我这边偏。
lines.en: When I watch you, the torch flame leans toward me.

lines.zh: 你后退，我的头跟着低下去。
lines.en: You step back and my head dips after you.

lines.zh: 我们隔着三格，我觉得太远。
lines.en: Three blocks apart, and I find it too far.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛反着你的火光，很亮。
lines.en: My eyes catch your torchlight, very bright.

lines.zh: 我不出声，只用脸的朝向回答你。
lines.en: I answer only with the direction of my face.

lines.zh: 你喊我的名字，我停了一瞬。
lines.en: You say my name, and I pause for a moment.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，退了半步，仅此而已。
lines.en: I take the hit, give half a step, nothing more.

lines.zh: 我的伤口没有血，只有一层灰。
lines.en: My wound bleeds nothing, only gray dust.

lines.zh: 我被砍中，衣服裂开，里面是空的。
lines.en: The blade cuts my clothes, and inside is empty.

lines.zh: 我发出一种不像喉咙发出的声音。
lines.en: I make a sound no throat should make.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，然后慢慢正过来。
lines.en: I tilt, then slowly straighten.

lines.zh: 我受了伤，反而更靠近你。
lines.en: Wounded, I only come closer.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂下去，又抬了起来。
lines.en: My arm falls, then rises again.

lines.zh: 你打中我，手上一阵发麻。
lines.en: You strike me and your hand goes numb.

lines.zh: 我退了，退的方向是你身后。
lines.en: I retreat, and I retreat to behind you.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，像在看别人的。
lines.en: I look at the wound as if it belonged to someone else.

lines.zh: 你丢出食物，我连看都不看。
lines.en: You toss out food, and I do not even look.

lines.zh: 你举起火把晃，我的头跟着晃。
lines.en: You wave the torch and my head sways with it.

lines.zh: 你手里的光比食物更吸引我。
lines.en: The light in your hand draws me more than food.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在地上，我踩着它过来。
lines.en: You set it on the ground and I walk over it.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，不是接，是够。
lines.en: I reach out, not to take, but to grab.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我前进一步。
lines.en: You give half a step, I take a full one.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只是想让你别走。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only want you to stay.

lines.zh: 你晃动的钥匙声让我停住。
lines.en: The jingle of your keys stops me.

lines.zh: 你举着东西当诱饵，我知道。
lines.en: You hold it out as bait, and I know it.

lines.zh: 我快了一步，你收得也快。
lines.en: I am a step faster, and you pull back just as fast.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，你被推得退了两格。
lines.en: I hit you and you slide back two blocks.

lines.zh: 你撞进我怀里，那里没有温度。
lines.en: You run into me, and there is no warmth there.

lines.zh: 我用手臂横过来，挡住整条走廊。
lines.en: I bar my arm across, blocking the whole hall.

lines.zh: 我被你撞开，又立刻站回原位。
lines.en: Knocked aside, I take my place again at once.

lines.zh: 我的身体像一堵会移动的墙。
lines.en: My body is a wall that walks.

lines.zh: 你从我腋下钻过，我转过身。
lines.en: You duck under my arm, and I turn around.

lines.zh: 我顶你一下，你的靴子在土上滑。
lines.en: I shove once and your boots skid.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，声音闷得像撞进棉被。
lines.en: We collide with a thud, like hitting a mattress.

lines.zh: 我把你挤到墙角，然后停住。
lines.en: I crowd you into the corner and then stop.

lines.zh: 你推我，我一步没动。
lines.en: You push me, and I do not move an inch.

lines.zh: 另一个我也来了，脸和你的一样模糊。
lines.en: Another one of me comes, its face as blurred as yours.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，两个影子合成一个。
lines.en: We stand side by side, two shadows merging into one.

lines.zh: 它伸手搭上我的肩，手很沉。
lines.en: It lays a hand on my shoulder, and the hand is heavy.

lines.zh: 我们不发出声音，只是靠近。
lines.en: We make no sound; we only come closer.

lines.zh: 它的脸慢慢转过来，我看见了。
lines.en: Its face turns slowly, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，中间没有空隙。
lines.en: We press together with no gap between.

lines.zh: 两只手同时抬起来，方向相反。
lines.en: Two hands rise at once, in opposite directions.

lines.zh: 夜色里多了一个我，院门没开。
lines.en: Night brings another me, and the gate never opened.

lines.zh: 我们低头，像在商量该怎么赶你走。
lines.en: We bow our heads, as if deciding how to drive you out.

lines.zh: 结束后它走进墙里，墙没有破。
lines.en: Afterward it walks into the wall, and the wall stays whole.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的手腕，冰得像铁。
lines.en: You grab my wrist and it is cold as iron.

lines.zh: 你把我按在墙上，墙凹了一块。
lines.en: You pin me to the wall and it dents.

lines.zh: 你想拖走我，我沉得像埋着的石头。
lines.en: You try to drag me, and I am heavy as buried stone.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的领口，布料散成灰。
lines.en: You seize my collar and the cloth crumbles to dust.

lines.zh: 我任由你拉着，脚步跟上你。
lines.en: I let you pull me, my steps matching yours.

lines.zh: 你把我锁进笼子，笼子开始响。
lines.en: You lock me in a cage and the cage begins to rattle.

lines.zh: 你把我抬起来，我的重量忽轻忽重。
lines.en: You lift me, and my weight shifts light and heavy.

lines.zh: 你拽我时，我的手还指着你的脸。
lines.en: As you haul me, my hand keeps pointing at your face.

lines.zh: 你把我塞进门后，门关不上。
lines.en: You stuff me behind the door and it will not close.

lines.zh: 你松手了，我的手腕还留着你的手印。
lines.en: You let go, and your handprint stays on my wrist.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，距离一下子不重要。
lines.en: I see you, and distance stops mattering.

lines.zh: 我把头转正，对准你的位置。
lines.en: I straighten my head and aim it at your position.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀一沉，像准备好了。
lines.en: My shoulders drop, as if ready.

lines.zh: 你点亮火把的时候，我选定了你。
lines.en: You light a torch, and that is when I choose you.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，指向你的胸口。
lines.en: I raise one hand and point at your chest.

lines.zh: 我迈出第一步，地面轻轻震了一下。
lines.en: I take my first step and the ground trembles faintly.

lines.zh: 我锁住你，周围的鸟都不叫了。
lines.en: I lock on and the birds around us fall silent.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，钻进阴影里，朝你走。
lines.en: I lower myself into the shadow and come for you.

lines.zh: 我不再躲藏，这是最坏的消息。
lines.en: I stop hiding, and that is the worst news.

lines.zh: 我选目标从不改，你已经被选了。
lines.en: I never change targets, and you are chosen.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸变慢，慢得像在等你先动。
lines.en: My breathing slows, as if waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 我把脸朝向你，其他方向我不管了。
lines.en: I turn my face to you and ignore all other directions.

lines.zh: 你听见身后一声轻响，那是我。
lines.en: You hear a soft sound behind you, and it is me.

lines.zh: 我开始朝你走，一步也没有犹豫。
lines.en: I start toward you without a moment's doubt.

lines.zh: 我找到你了，这句话我在心里说了很久。
lines.en: I have found you; I have said that to myself a long time.

lines.zh: 我把你圈进我的路线，路只剩一条。
lines.en: I fold you into my path, and only one route remains.

lines.zh: 我在你后面五格，一直保持五格。
lines.en: I stay five blocks behind, always five.

lines.zh: 你跑，我就走，速度刚好追得上。
lines.en: You run, I walk, and the pace is just enough.

lines.zh: 你躲进屋，我停在门外数到十。
lines.en: You hide indoors; I stand outside and count to ten.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我的路线也跟着弯。
lines.en: You change direction and my route bends with you.

lines.zh: 我跟着你穿过整片林子，没踩断一根枝。
lines.en: I follow you through the whole wood without snapping a twig.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我正好在树后。
lines.en: You look back, and I am exactly behind a tree.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路一段一段堵上。
lines.en: I seal off your escape routes one stretch at a time.

lines.zh: 你听见我在墙那边，声音越来越近。
lines.en: You hear me on the other side of the wall, closer each time.

lines.zh: 我一直在你的视野边缘，不进去。
lines.en: I stay at the edge of your vision, never entering.

lines.zh: 你停下喘气，我也停下，等你说完。
lines.en: You stop to catch your breath, and I wait for you to finish.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳，比你自己清楚。
lines.en: I count your heartbeat, better than you do.

lines.zh: 你往东，我提前到了东边。
lines.en: You go east, and I am already there.

lines.zh: 我不喊不叫，跟着就是全部。
lines.en: I do not shout or call; following is everything.

lines.zh: 你点亮第二支火把，我的影子变长了。
lines.en: You light a second torch and my shadow grows.

lines.zh: 你把自己关起来，我在外面等门开。
lines.en: You shut yourself in, and I wait outside for the door.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和你的脚步重合了。
lines.en: My footsteps have merged with yours.

lines.zh: 你绕了三圈，我一圈都没绕。
lines.en: You circle three times; I take no detour at all.

lines.zh: 我知道你累了，因为你开始回头。
lines.en: I know you are tired, because you have started to look back.

lines.zh: 我离你还有两格，这两格会消失。
lines.en: Two blocks remain between us, and they will go.

lines.zh: 你退到水边，我在岸上不动。
lines.en: You back to the water's edge; I stand still on the bank.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下，你的护甲凹了进去。
lines.en: I bring my palm down and your armor dents.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩膀，指头陷进肉里。
lines.en: I seize your shoulder, fingers sinking in.

lines.zh: 我把你举起来，又放开手。
lines.en: I lift you up, then let go.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸在地上，你站不稳。
lines.en: I drive a fist into the ground and you lose your footing.

lines.zh: 我用手臂扫过，你被推得撞上树。
lines.en: I sweep my arm and you slam into a tree.

lines.zh: 我按住你的头，往墙上送。
lines.en: I take your head and push it toward the wall.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比你整个人还沉。
lines.en: My fist is heavier than your whole body.

lines.zh: 我出手很慢，落点却总是对的。
lines.en: My swing is slow, but it always lands right.

lines.zh: 我掐住你的喉咙，力气大得不像手。
lines.en: I close a hand on your throat with impossible strength.

lines.zh: 我打完退开半步，等你再站起来。
lines.en: After the blow I step back and wait for you to rise.

lines.zh: 我从背后抱住你，然后收紧。
lines.en: I wrap you from behind, then tighten.

lines.zh: 我踢你膝盖，你跪下去，我又等。
lines.en: I kick your knee, you kneel, and I wait again.

lines.zh: 我的手指在你脸上找眼睛。
lines.en: My fingers search your face for the eyes.

lines.zh: 我一次只出一招，招招都重。
lines.en: One blow at a time, and every blow is heavy.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I grip your wrist and a bone clicks.

lines.zh: 我松开你的时候，你已经站不直。
lines.en: When I let go, you can no longer stand straight.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就在那儿，本来没有。
lines.en: You look back and I am there, where nothing was.

lines.zh: 夜里多了一个影子，比人高。
lines.en: Night brings a shadow taller than a person.

lines.zh: 屋子里忽然很安静，然后我出现了。
lines.en: The house goes quiet, and then I appear.

lines.zh: 我从你身后的雾里走出来，雾没散。
lines.en: I step out of the fog behind you, and it does not clear.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋落在你脚边，我先看你。
lines.en: The spawn egg falls at your feet, and I look at you first.

lines.zh: 你听见门外有脚步，门一直是关的。
lines.en: You hear steps outside the door, and the door stayed shut.

lines.zh: 我站在你刚离开的位置，姿势一样。
lines.en: I stand where you just were, in the same pose.

lines.zh: 灯灭了半秒，我就在那半秒里来了。
lines.en: The light fails half a second, and I arrive in it.

lines.zh: 田地尽头有一个我不认识的人形。
lines.en: At the field's end stands a figure I do not know.

lines.zh: 我从地里站起来，土没有翻动。
lines.en: I rise out of the ground, and the soil is undisturbed.

lines.zh: 有东西在你家里等你，你还没进门。
lines.en: Something waits in your house before you enter it.

lines.zh: 我出现时，附近的动物全跑了。
lines.en: When I appear, every nearby animal flees.

lines.zh: 你数着屋子里的影子，多了一个。
lines.en: You count the shadows in the room, and one is extra.

lines.zh: 我站在路中间，路本来没有岔口。
lines.en: I stand in the road, where there was never a fork.

lines.zh: 你听见有人叫你的名字，声音是我。
lines.en: You hear your name called, and the voice is mine.

lines.zh: 我从你的床脚起身，你才醒。
lines.en: I rise at the foot of your bed just as you wake.

lines.zh: 门口多了一双鞋，人还没进来。
lines.en: A pair of boots waits at the door, and no one has come in.

lines.zh: 我从画里走出来，画布没有破。
lines.en: I step out of the painting and the canvas stays whole.

lines.zh: 世界抖了一下，然后我在这里了。
lines.en: The world shudders once, and then I am here.

lines.zh: 我站在你的出生点，等你回来。
lines.en: I stand at your spawn point, waiting for you to return.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，我像没感觉。
lines.en: Fire burns on me, and I seem not to feel it.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，落地时地陷了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and the ground caves in.

lines.zh: 水没过头顶，我站在水底看你。
lines.en: Water closes over me and I stand on the bottom, watching.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开我，边缘很快合上。
lines.en: The blast tears me open and the edges close again.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，我一根根拔掉。
lines.en: Arrows stick in me, and I pull them out one by one.

lines.zh: 药水的光烧着我，我退了。
lines.en: The potion's light sears me and I back off.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，也不会饿，只是变薄。
lines.en: I do not eat and cannot starve; I only thin out.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我亮得像块牌子。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I light up like a sign.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，还在往下看你。
lines.en: I fall into the void, still looking up at you.
